highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces Graphite GPU backends on Skia m152.
highlights_body: It also adds backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback and a Silk.NET Vulkan helper, strengthens native-memory lifetimes, and improves several managed hot paths.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152, rolls VulkanMemoryAllocator to 3.4.0, and preserves the Vulkan allocator fallback used by SkiaSharp callers.
Includes m151 font-rendering and Ganesh stability fixes, including a correction that prevents stale texture data after pending render tasks fail to flush.
Exposes contexts, recorders, recordings, textures, and Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn backend contexts for Skia's next-generation GPU architecture, including browser WebGPU through Dawn.
Adds RequestReadPixels to SKImage and SKSurface, callback-scoped SKImageReadPixelsResult access, rescale options, copy-out helpers, and GRContext.CheckAsyncWorkCompletion for deferred Ganesh work.
Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET convenience package for cross-platform Vulkan contexts and makes the parameterless GRVkExtensions constructor public.
Region iterators now retain their source SKRegion, while SKPixmap subset and With* results retain their ultimate pixel owner, preventing use-after-free failures.

bullets.lead: Failed raster image creation no longer leaks
bullets.detail: SKImage.Create(SKImageInfo) now frees its unmanaged pixel buffer when native raster-image creation fails.
Span-capable targets now write the native buffer directly to the destination stream, removing the intermediate buffer copy and roughly doubling measured throughput.

bullets.lead: Native wrapper creation avoids repeated reflection
bullets.detail: Caches each wrapper type's skip-registration decision so frequently used HandleDictionary paths no longer repeat Type.IsAssignableFrom checks.

bullets.lead: Managed marshalling and uniform setup allocate less
bullets.detail: Null-terminated encoded text no longer needs an intermediate string, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its name lookup map to the known uniform count.

bullets.lead: Caller-supplied fonts render on Nano Server
bullets.detail: The Nano Server native asset now uses bundled FreeType, allowing typefaces loaded through SKTypeface.FromStream, FromData, or FromFile to render without DirectWrite.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: FreeType-backed rendering for caller-supplied fonts on Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Faster Windows native builds by initializing the MSVC environment once per architecture
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.summary: Moves to Skia m152 with upstream font and Ganesh fixes; adds Graphite, asynchronous pixel readback, Silk.NET Vulkan integration, and Nano Server font support. Fixes iterator, pixmap, and raster-allocation lifetimes while improving SKData.SaveTo, wrapper creation, text marshalling, and uniform setup.

harfbuzz_summary: This preview co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 rather than 14.2.1.1, with no HarfBuzz binding changes in this scope.
